nodes.name: Decision Packet Schema.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph artifact_schema node documenting the Decision Packet data contract produced by the supervisor decision engine, including its field shape, validation rules, and consuming modules.
nodes.languageNotes: Ontology-governed dev_graph node with structured frontmatter (type: artifact_schema) and a required Relationships section for Neo4j export.

nodes.name: Evaluation Scorecard Schema.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph artifact_schema node documenting the Evaluation Scorecard contract used by the decision engine and decision API to capture scored evaluation outcomes.

nodes.name: Execution Record Schema.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph artifact_schema node defining the Execution Record contract emitted by the Execution layer; it consumes the Runtime Decision Record and feeds position tracking.
nodes.languageNotes: Illustrative v0 contract marked non-normative until frozen at code; documents an upstream→downstream consume chain from runtime decisions to execution records.

nodes.name: Feature Vector Schema.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph artifact_schema node defining the Feature Vector contract produced by the Feature Builder and consumed by the regime classifier and gold decision builder.

nodes.name: Gold DecisionPacket v0 Schema.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph artifact_schema node specifying the deterministic GoldDecisionPacket output of the Gold Decision Builder, derived from a Feature Vector plus a Regime Classification with versioned identity and guard provenance.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents a deterministic, replay-safe contract with SHA-256 identity hashing over a versioned tuple; the most detailed schema in the batch, consuming two other in-batch schemas.

nodes.name: Layer 2 Snapshot Schema.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph artifact_schema node defining the Layer 2 Snapshot contract — the deterministic market-data snapshot that anchors all downstream feature, regime, and decision artifacts.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines a deterministic identity (recompute_id) so the same snapshot reproduces stable downstream artifacts.

nodes.name: Portfolio State Schema.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph artifact_schema node defining the Portfolio State contract produced and consumed by the Execution layer and read by position tracking.
nodes.languageNotes: Illustrative v0 contract marked non-normative until frozen at code; originates from the Stateless Agent Architecture principle.

nodes.name: Regime Classification Schema.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph artifact_schema node defining the Regime Classification contract produced by the Market Regime Classifier and consumed by the gold decision builder.

nodes.name: Runtime Decision Record Schema.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph artifact_schema node defining the Runtime Decision Record contract produced by the Paper-Trading Runtime, which wraps and consumes a Gold DecisionPacket plus computed L3 guard outcomes.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents the runtime wrapper around the pure gold packet; carries the stateful guard outcomes (duplicate_ok/operational_ok) the planning packet leaves null.

nodes.name: Runtime Ledger Schema.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph artifact_schema node defining the Runtime Ledger contract — the append-only record produced and consumed by the Paper-Trading Runtime for replay-safe paper-trade accounting.

nodes.name: Trade Validation Decision Schema.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph artifact_schema node defining the Trade Validation Decision contract returned by the Guardrail Engine / Risk Check API to approve or reject a proposed trade.

nodes.name: Trade Validation Request Schema.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph artifact_schema node defining the Trade Validation Request contract consumed by the Guardrail Engine / Risk Check API as the input to a trade risk check.
